terms.gloss: with the due religious rites; hence duly, properly, rightly
evidence: Cic. Leg. 2.21: quae prō populō rīte fīent (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: ut Arātus ab Jove incipiendum putat, ita nōs rīte coeptūrī ab Homērō vidēmur
phrases.english: as Aratus thinks one must begin with Jupiter, so we shall rightly begin with Homer

sources: Lewis & Short: rite
